packageRules.description: Carry both crates in one PR so a version split shows up as a reviewable update instead of a compile error. src/fetch/converter.rs matches htmd's re-exported Node against markup5ever_rcdom's NodeData, so the two must resolve to the same compiled type.

Hold markup5ever_rcdom at the 0.38 line htmd 0.5.5 requires. Grouping alone does not stop a lone bump: renovate places co-occurring updates in one PR, but still opens a PR for whichever crate has an update. PR #374 bumped this crate alone and failed with error[E0308] on the two NodeData sites. Raise the bound once htmd depends on markup5ever_rcdom 0.39, and update the pin in Cargo.toml in the same change.
